name: softglaze-browser
description: Skills for working with SoftGlaze Browser profiles from Claude: check profile and proxy health, find why a profile gets CAPTCHAs, fix timezone and language mismatches, write and run macros, and test your own site from other countries. The skills use SoftGlaze's own AI tools, which run inside SoftGlaze Browser 1.0.22 or newer on your Windows computer; the skills show you how to connect them. Every change waits for your approval in the SoftGlaze app.
